All 5 recorded prints were down (median |move| 5.19%), so this name sells its beats.
evidence.why_not_priced: UCTT's Q3 consensus ($727.5m) still sits at the midpoint of a guide set on Aug 3, before Lam printed. If the market were pricing a top-end beat, Q3 estimates would sit above $750m and the stock would not have fallen 15% on the day Lam reported a 22% q/q revenue jump. That sell-off traded Lam's December deceleration, not Lam's September strength.
